name: record_01
evidence: The HER2 monomer 2Rs15D had a terminal beta-half-life of 1.0 hour; the unmodified trimer 3x2Rs15D had 1.3 hours; the negatively charged trimer 3x(-)2Rs15D had 5.8 hours. All retained HER2 binding; negative engineering changed KD by approximately 1.8-fold versus the unmodified trimer.

name: record_02
evidence: Six-week-old female BALB/c mice received 100 µg IP. Terminal sampling covered 30 minutes to 24 hours, with selected trimers followed to 48 hours. ELISA quantification reached 100 pM. No toxin-binding constructs are supplied.
